name: io.github.tengence-team/geo
title: Tengence GEO Agent
description: GEO/SEO content pipeline MCP: plan, write, gate-check, publish, submit, monitor AI visibility.

environmentVariables.name: SITES_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Root directory holding per-site config and .env files. Optional; the workspace is chosen at runtime via the workspace_use tool.

environmentVariables.name: TENGENCE_GEO_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Internal runtime data directory (DB, caches). Defaults to ~/.tengence/geo-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: DB_DRIVER
environmentVariables.description: Storage backend: sqlite (default) or mysql for production.
